title: Oyatie Audit Event Class Registry Schema
description: Canonical JSON Schema 2020-12 contract and known-class registry for audit-event classes governed by ADR-0263. The v2 registry consumes the oyatie/log/v2 audit envelope from specs/audit-event-schema.json: legacy v1 envelope fields, the ADR-0252 HLC timestamp, and ADR-0344 sustainability/FinOps fields are mandatory for new rows while ADR-0344 remains Proposed/advisory. Every new doctrine ADR that introduces audit events must extend this registry and keep ADR-0263 reverse references current.

_meta.purpose: Define the registry row shape for every approved audit-event class and expose the current known class set from ADR-0263 and ADR-0344. The validator refuses OpenAPI, AsyncAPI, proto, Cedar, workflow, observability, and FinOps contracts that emit free-form or unregistered classes.
_meta.v2_envelope_count_reconciliation: Registry v2 requires 17 mandatory envelope fields: the legacy 10-field class-registry example envelope, plus hlc_timestamp inherited from ADR-0252, plus the six ADR-0344 sustainability/FinOps fields. Older Wave 15Y 10-to-16 wording counted only the ADR-0344 additive fields and omitted HLC; HLC must not be dropped.

example_name.description: Optional example label used by named examples.

registry_id.description: Stable registry id for the ADR-0263 audit-event-class catalog.

version.description: Semantic version of the registry contract and class list.

mandatory_envelope_fields.description: Mandatory event envelope fields inherited by every registered class. For oyatie/log/v2 this is a 17-field envelope: legacy ADR-0263 fields + ADR-0252 hlc_timestamp + ADR-0344 cost/carbon/energy/provider/region/carbon_intensity_source fields.

cedar_decision_fields.description: Additional fields required when an event class is produced by a Cedar decision.

classes.description: Registered audit-event classes. Every emitted class must appear here with origin, severity, payload, cardinality, and retention metadata.

update_policy.description: Rules for extending the registry when a downstream ADR introduces new emitted classes.

requires_reverse_reference_to_adr_0344_w.description: Required when the class relies on oyatie/log/v2 sustainability/FinOps envelope fields from ADR-0344.

eventClassName.description: Canonical audit-event class identifier. Legacy ADR-0297/0313/0319 classes use PascalCase; ADR-0344 FinOps and schema-transition classes preserve the dotted constants named by finops-dimensional-model.json and audit-event-schema.json.

high_cardinality_allowed.description: True only when ADR text names the class as expected high-cardinality and the observability budget accounts for it.

Cedar abuse-defence fragment hot-reloads or activates.

SPIRE server is unreachable and SVID fallback is used.

Controlling-entity grant is revoked.
Parent tenant reads child tenant data under a valid grant.
Cross-jurisdiction grant action is constrained by residency policy.
Parent/child action is refused by information-barrier policy.

Front, middle, or back office scope assignment is created.
Office scope assignment is changed.
Office scope assignment is revoked.
User or workflow requests clearance across an office boundary.
Office boundary clearance is approved.
Office boundary clearance is denied.
Previously approved clearance is revoked.
Attempt to cross an office boundary is evaluated.
Attempt to cross an office boundary is denied.
Attempt to cross an office boundary is allowed.
Information barrier taint is attached to a record or derived artifact.
Information barrier taint propagates to derived material.
Information barrier taint is released by policy.
Restricted deal record is created.
Participant is added to restricted deal.
Participant is removed from restricted deal.
Restricted deal exits restricted status.
Advisor relationship barrier is created.
Attempt involving advisor relationship barrier is evaluated.
Office pack overlay is activated.
Office pack overlay changes.
Office pack overlay is retired.
HR lifecycle metadata envelope is prepared for later runtime audit-chain emission.
HR sensitive-read policy decision is evaluated for later runtime audit-chain emission.

finops-portal dimensional rollup p99 freshness exceeds its five-minute tenant/hour budget.
